_about: Fixed test scenes for tools/render_score.sh (renderer score: PS2 vs the PC and Xbox ports). No game data here.
Each scene is a lockstep run (tools/referee.py's machinery): the PS2 (owner's disc in PCSX2) departs on QUEST from the
referee's gate save state (or, village: true, stays in the village), stopped at the start of every game tick; the PC
and the Xbox play the same play ticks with the PS2's save, random state and pad. So hunter, monsters, camera and
random numbers are the PS2's own on all three (no frozen RNG or forced camera needed) up to the referee's first
difference (docs/RELEASE_G.md section 11), which comes later than these shots.
fields: id, game (mhg | mh1), quest, village (bool), area [STAGE, X, Z, FACING] or [STAGE, "start", FACING]
("start": the stage's start position, stage_start_pos, read from the PS2) poked as an area exit at play tick
area_tick (default 30), pad (tools/referee.py pad names; default idle), shot (the play tick pictured), mask: rectangles
[x, y, w, h] in 640x448 that the metrics leave out (the HUD: the PS2 cannot switch its HUD off without patching
code, so 'HUD off' is a mask), what: a description.
